Title: MemorySmith.Agent — ActionOutcome & StructuredEffect: Universal Tool Result
Content:
## Overview

ActionOutcome (Agent.Core/Models/ActionOutcome.cs) is the universal result artifact for every ToolDispatcher.CallAsync execution. It is the single result type flowing into recovery, replanning, journaling, and world-state updates.

## OutcomeType Enum (Sprint 40 P0-B)

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| Completed | Action completed successfully and produced expected result |
| NoProgress | Action completed but no measurable progress (item not collected, wrong output) |
| Failed | Action failed due to an error or exception |
| Blocked | Prerequisite not met (no reachable block, missing tool, insufficient items) |
| Unreachable | Target was unreachable (pathfinding failure) |
| TimedOut | Action timed out before completing |

Replaced the original bool Success field. The Success property is now computed: true for Completed only.

## ActionOutcome Record

Fields:
- GoalId (Guid): links outcome to the active goal
- ToolName (string): the tool that produced this outcome (e.g. "MineBlock")
- Outcome (OutcomeType): semantic status
- ObservationSummary (string): human-readable description of what happened
- Effects (IReadOnlyList<StructuredEffect>): typed list of world changes
- Timestamp (DateTimeOffset): when the outcome was recorded
- Success (bool, computed): true when Outcome == Completed

Implements IObservationSummary for LLM evaluator consumption.

### Factory Helpers
- ActionOutcome.Collected(goalId, tool, item, count): OutcomeType.Completed + ItemCollected effect
- ActionOutcome.Succeeded(goalId, tool, summary): OutcomeType.Completed, no effects
- ActionOutcome.Failed(goalId, tool, reason): OutcomeType.Failed

## StructuredEffect Record

Fields: Type (string), Item (string?), Count (int?), Detail (string?)

Type vocabulary:
- ItemCollected: item landed in inventory (playerCollect, craft/smelt output)
- ItemConsumed: item removed from inventory (placed, used as ingredient)
- ItemCrafted: item crafted at table/furnace
- PositionChanged: bot moved to new location
- BlockPlaced: block placed in world
- BlockMined: block removed from world
- StatusRefreshed: full bot status refreshed (HP, food, inventory)
- MemorySearched: MemorySmith search executed
- MemoryPageCreated: new MemorySmith page created

## Consumers

1. AgentJournal: records ActionOutcome for post-hoc analysis (Append, GetRecent, Clear)
2. AgentBackgroundService: uses ActionOutcome as WorldState update hints in observation-driven replanning
3. ILlmEvaluator.EvaluateAsync(goal, outcomes): receives ActionOutcome[] to decide if replanning is needed (Sprint 39 stub, Sprint 45+ concrete)
4. IReplanGovernor: uses outcome data for stall detection
